title: Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den
synopsis: In the kingdom of Ei, the Maiden Court is located within the palace's inner court, whose purpose is to nurture the next empress and four imperial consorts from five prominent clans. The crown prince's...
synopsis_es:
En el reino de Ei, la Corte de las Doncellas se encuentra dentro del patio interior del palacio, cuyo propósito es criar a la próxima emperatriz y a cuatro consortes imperiales de cinco clanes prominentes. La favorita del príncipe heredero es la virtuosa Reirin Kou, sobresaliendo en cada tarea que se le asigna a pesar de su enfermiza constitución. Por el contrario, Keigetsu Shu es considerada un obstáculo debido a su conducta maleducada. Mientras que Reirin es una elegante mariposa amada por todos, Keigetsu es una rata de alcantarilla a la que nadie se atreve a mirar.

Durante el Festival Double Sevens, Keigetsu, celoso, intenta asesinar a Reirin empujándola desde un balcón. Afortunadamente, Reirin se salva de una muerte prematura, mientras que Keigetsu está encarcelada y espera su castigo. Sin que todos lo sepan, Keigetsu ha usado magia prohibida para intercambiar cuerpos con Reirin, deseando tener la vida perfecta de Reirin. 

Sin embargo, no todo va según el plan de Keigetsu, ya que el débil cuerpo de Reirin obstruye sus malvados planes. Al mismo tiempo, Reirin disfruta de la buena forma física de Keigetsu. Al no estar sujeta a reglas, Reirin asume la misión de vivir interpretando el papel de una villana, sin importar cuán inepta pueda ser.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
episodes_data.description: On the night of the Double Sevens Festival, Maiden Kou Reirin is forced to swap bodies with the much hated Shu Keigetsu. However, Reirin rejoices about the fact...?

episodes_data.title: Will I Be Living Here?
episodes_data.description: As a result of the commotion in the inner court, Reirin is ordered by Noble Consort Shu to relocate her room, though this is simply banishment in disguise. Because the new abode is basically an abandoned shed, Leelee the personal court lady for Keigetsu unleashes the frustrations that has been building up within her heart.

episodes_data.title: Shoulders Back, Look Forward
episodes_data.description: It has been four days since the swap. Reirin, who has been bahished to a hut in the Shu Palace, devotes herself to farming utilizing Keigetsu`s healthy body. Enjoying a freedom where she doesn`t trouble anyone, Reirin spends her days feeling fulfilled. Meanwhile, Leelee is provoked by Gayou, a high court lady from the Kin family who suddenly appeared before her, to harass Reirin...

episodes_data.title: Who Is That Girl?
episodes_data.description: To settle the score with Gayou, Reirin and Leelee head to the Ghost Festival ritual. Kin Seika the hostess performs a marvelous dance...

episodes_data.title: I Won't Let You Die
episodes_data.description: The Kou clan court lady Tousetsu reports that "Reirin" is in critical condition. Wanting to save Keigetsu, Reirin is given a certain task by the empress...

episodes_data.title: Meaning of Entrusting a Weapon
episodes_data.description: Tousetsu catches onto the Maidens` swap. Keigetsu realizes a gift is cursed. The empress Kenshuu looks back on her memories together with Noble Consort Shu...

episodes_data.title: Like a Villainess, Like a Villainess
episodes_data.description: Reirin hypothesizes there is a mastermind behind the harassment. She calls for Keigetsu through the flames, but Keigetsu is the one asking for help...
episodes_data.title_es: Como una villana, como una villana

episodes_data.title: I Will Make Sure to Save You
episodes_data.description: Reirin realizes that Kenshuu`s agony is that of a curse, which gives her an understanding of Gabi`s true objective. Reirin asks Gyoumei if she can borrow the Bow of Warding once more, but he will not heed her request. Unable to give up, Reirin heads over alone to see Keigetsu and have the swap cancelled. Right as she passes by Gyoumei, a certain image catches his eye...

episodes_data.title: Split Curses, Too
episodes_data.description: Reirin and Keigetsu try to break the curse while Shin-u and the prince investigate it.
